0022600133.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers, who are 1-1 and on a W1 streak, host the Washington Wizards, who are 2-1 and also on a W1 streak. Cleveland sits 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the East, while Washington is 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East. Washington will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision.
